_about: Stand-alone drop pages for the homepage timeline (cathedral.js drops(), 11/10). One row each: up = the day it went up, link = the drop's own folder, thumb = a 16:9 card inside it, go = the call to action.

items.title: RELIQUARY special: The After Party
items.line: Part 2 of the BLOODBATH special, on a home video: the DJ kills the lights for the drop, the champ belt disappears, and a crew of thieves gets robbed at their own party. A special, not canon. 10 screens, read top to bottom.

items.title: RELIQUARY special: BLOODBATH 4
items.line: The fight card for BLOODBATH 4, Friday the 13th: Kuro vs MINO, Bala vs CY, and the Apostates vs HYDRA for the champ belt. A special, not canon. 10 pages, read top to bottom.

items.title: RELIQUARY origins #3: Lena
items.line: Lena's origin, told on the certificates she writes for every fake she sells. Every fake got one. The real one didn't. 10 slides, read top to bottom.

items.title: RELIQUARY origins #2: Relic
items.line: Relic's origin, seen through the glass of her display case. Everybody looked at her. Nobody saw her. 10 slides, read top to bottom.

items.title: RELIQUARY origins #1: Rin
items.line: Rin's origin, told in her texts with CINDER (NO). Months of 3am favors before night one. 10 slides, read top to bottom.

items.title: RELIQUARY ep. 1
items.line: The manhwa starts here. 3:07 AM in Santa Ossa, printed on one long church receipt. 20 slides, read top to bottom.

items.title: RELIQUARY: the lore
items.line: The church owns every miracle in Santa Ossa. Twelve misfits rob it for a living. Three carousels, 41 slides, a caption on every one.

items.title: Type in my handwriting
items.line: VP Deadeye, my hand lettering made into a font. Every letter inked by hand. Free for anything, even paid work.

items.title: Pick your lock screen
items.line: 10 free lock screens of the crew, night and day. Tap one and save it.
